tasks_completed.description: Constrain filePath Text in SidebarFileView with numberOfLines + ellipsizeMode + flexShrink
tasks_completed.changes: Line 49-55: replaced <Text style={styles.filePath}>{filePath.replace(/\//g, '/\u200B')}</Text> with multi-line form <Text style={styles.filePath} numberOfLines={1} ellipsizeMode="middle">{filePath}</Text>. Removed U+200B zero-width space insertion (redundant with single-line clamp). Line 225: added flexShrink: 1 to styles.filePath style object.
tasks_completed.rationale: Root cause: styles.filePath had no width constraint and the Text had no numberOfLines, so web RN expanded it to intrinsic width beyond the 450px panel. Fix per BA spec: numberOfLines={1} + ellipsizeMode='middle' applies middle ellipsis; flexShrink:1 is mandatory on web so the Text yields to parent container width.

tasks_completed.description: Constrain per-file filePath Text in CodexPatchView with numberOfLines + ellipsizeMode
tasks_completed.changes: Line 119: replaced <Text style={styles.filePath}>{filePath}</Text> with <Text style={styles.filePath} numberOfLines={1} ellipsizeMode="middle">{filePath}</Text>. No change to styles.filePath (already has flex:1 per QA-BA R2 objection).
tasks_completed.rationale: Same overflow pattern as SidebarFileView but styles.filePath already has flex:1. Per QA-BA objection, did NOT add flexShrink:1 there. Used inline single-line JSX form to avoid increasing nesting depth in pre-existing quality-gate-flagged region.

git_rationale.root_cause_commit: N/A — not a regression; missing constraint since initial SidebarFileView implementation
git_rationale.why_issue_occurred: styles.filePath was originally authored with cosmetic properties only (fontSize/fontWeight/color/marginBottom). Web RN does not apply any width constraint to Text by default, so an unconstrained Text inside a vertical ScrollView expands to its intrinsic width, escaping the 450px panel bounds when file paths are long (e.g. /dev/shm/dev-workspace/applio/.claude/worktrees/... overnight-worktree paths 100+ chars).
git_rationale.how_fix_addresses_root: numberOfLines={1} + ellipsizeMode='middle' are React Native Text built-ins that clamp to single-line with middle ellipsis when parent width is bounded. flexShrink:1 on the filePath style ensures the Text yields to its parent's width rather than demanding its intrinsic width. Remove U+200B since soft-wrap opportunities are irrelevant inside a single-line clamp.

dev.qa_notes: VISUAL verification required at BOTH 1280x720 desktop AND 390x844 mobile viewports. Test scenarios: (1) Open detail panel for Edit/Write/MultiEdit tool call with file_path > 80 chars (e.g. a dev/shm/dev-workspace/... worktree path). Expect: path clamped to single line with middle ellipsis like '/dev/shm/...user-feedback.md', fully contained within 450px panel bounds — zero horizontal overflow. (2) Open detail panel for a CodexPatch tool call with multi-file changes whose per-file paths are long. Expect: each per-file label clamped in same way inside its fileHeaderMain row (kindLabel pill still visible right of the ellipsized text). (3) Short paths (< 60 chars) should render fully with no ellipsis at both viewport widths. (4) Path text should remain selectable (RN default) so the user can still copy-select the visible portion; R2 clipboard affordance is deferred. Pre-existing TypeScript error at SidebarFileView.tsx:246 (theme.colors.background in tabTextActive style) is NOT caused by this cycle and was present before.

Worked around via direct python file write.
